name: OASIS Open Agentic Survey Interview System
free_limit: AGPL-3.0-only self-hosted conversational survey and research interview platform with text and voice workflows, participant tracking, and transcript export; no software subscription or vendor-imposed usage quota.
watch_out: Supply your own Docker infrastructure, PostgreSQL, Redis, and model/STT/TTS resources. External LLM, voice, or Twilio APIs may charge per use; voice-to-voice relies on proprietary providers. AGPL network-service source-sharing obligations apply to modifications; project is young.
